issue_context.title: Shelly BLU BTHome Unexpected error
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I created 3 automations for the button:
-long press: turn lights off
-short press: turn lights on 30%
-double press: turn lights on 100%

These working fine, until i turn on the beacon mode for the button. Then it starts sending beacons every 8 seconds and triggers the last button press with every beacon.
I checked this with the Shelly BLU debug app, the button is sending the beacon only without keypress, but HASS triggers the last valid keypress event again and again.

The weird thing is that the automations seems working, but the log remains empty.

Sometimes i get this in the docker terminal after long pressing the button (regardless, the long press event will be executed):

```
2023-05-07 17:25:21.579 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.bthome] Unexpected error updating BC:02:6E:C3:B4:97 data: 254                        
Traceback (most recent call last):                                                                                                                        
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/bluetooth/passive_update_processor.py", line 124, in _async_handle_bluetooth_event                
    update = self._update_method(service_info)                                                                                                            
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/bthome/__init__.py", line 112, in <lambda>                                                        
    update_method=lambda service_info: process_service_info(                                                                                              
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/bthome/__init__.py", line 44, in process_service_info                                             
    update = data.update(service_info)                                                                                                                    
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/bluetooth_sensor_state_data/__init__.py", line 71, in update                                              
    self._start_update(data)                                                                                                                              
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/bthome_ble/parser.py", line 168, in _start_update                                                         
    if self._parse_bthome_v2(service_info, service_info.name, data):                                                                                      
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/bthome_ble/parser.py", line 314, in _parse_bthome_v2                                                      
    return self._parse_payload(payload, sw_version)                                                                                                       
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/bthome_ble/parser.py", line 450, in _parse_payload                                                        
    event_type = parse_event_type(                                                                                                                        
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/bthome_ble/parser.py", line 89, in parse_event_type                                                       
    event_type = BUTTON_EVENTS[data_obj]                                                                                                                  
KeyError: 254  
```


Using the latest (2023.5.2) docker version on a Synology DS220+ NAS and Shelly Plus Plug S as BTHome proxy. 

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.5.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

BTHome

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

[home-assistant_bthome_2023-05-07T17-35-45.571Z.log](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/11415625/home-assistant_bthome_2023-05-07T17-35-45.571Z.log)


### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
comments: I will check what happens in beacon mode later, but the error is indicating that the button is sending a Button Event `0xFE`. Only `0x00` till `0x06` are allowed BTHome button events. This should be fixed in the Shelly Firmware.

Update:
The Shelly device got a firmware update ( 20230606-105508\/v1.0.7-rc3@99932126 ). 
Hass version is now 2023.6.2 (auto-updated docker image)
The behavior is the same if beacon mode is on:

`2023-06-18 13:54:56.411 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.bthome] Unexpected error updating BC:02:6E:C3:B4:97 data: 254
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/bluetooth/passive_update_processor.py", line 124, in _async_handle_bluetooth_event
    update = self._update_method(service_info)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/bthome/__init__.py", line 108, in <lambda>
    update_method=lambda service_info: process_service_info(
                                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/bthome/__init__.py", line 41, in process_service_info
    update = data.update(service_info)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/bluetooth_sensor_state_data/__init__.py", line 71, in update
    self._start_update(data)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/bthome_ble/parser.py", line 171, in _start_update
    if self._parse_bthome_v2(service_info, service_info.name, data):
       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/bthome_ble/parser.py", line 332, in _parse_bthome_v2
    return self._parse_payload(payload, sw_version)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/bthome_ble/parser.py", line 468, in _parse_payload
    event_type = parse_event_type(
                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/bthome_ble/parser.py", line 89, in parse_event_type
    event_type = BUTTON_EVENTS[data_obj]
                 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^
KeyError: 254`


I see these in the HASS event log:

`event_type: bthome_ble_event
data:
  device_id: 41a0cc08c0aefd2e87091d3470c2c4a1
  address: BC:02:6E:C3:B4:97
  event_class: button
  event_type: long_press
  event_properties: null
origin: LOCAL
time_fired: "2023-06-18T14:00:07.773646+00:00"
context:
  id: 01H37CWMAXVEKYW0Y7SPYNX7M9
  parent_id: null
  user_id: null
`

The context ID changes every time, but the event_type is always my latest action, repatedly.  Meanwhile, if i scan these packets in the Shelly BLU debug app, it reports presses / no-press events correctly.

Another interesting thing:
I just started the ble-shelly-btn.js from the library on a Plus Plug S and started monitoring things.
I got these in the log:

`Shelly BTH packet: {"encryption":false,"BTHome_version":2,"pid":248,"Battery":85,"Button":0,"addr":"bc:02:6e:c3:b4:97","rssi":-64}`

It returns 0 for beacon, 1-2-3 for short presses and 4 for long press.

#94822 should fix the error messages, by dropping the bthome messages with button event = 254. 254 is not an official [bthome](https://bthome.io) button event, only 0-6 are allowed. I'll contact Shelly why they use 254. 

The behavior in beacon mode is being discussed in #93502
